items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Dick -- Richard Gibson stepped in there and helped me get over that, so all these things came -- nobody had any qualms about hiring me again.

ctx.x: And these people have been most gracious, and I don't think the world knows about them or have accepted them. They're not even interested in being accepted -- they are just Americans who believe in this truly great art of American jazz, and I think we can start with Richard Gibson.
Richard Gibson, started almost from the ground floor, number one.
